channel.title: Removal Queue Updates
channel.description: Updates for installed Removal Queue plug-ins.

item.title: Removal Queue 0.5.2 Preview
item.description:
Removal Queue 0.5.2 Preview makes processing and review simpler.
- Process Marked Photos starts directly after scanning. A short prompt appears only if some marked photos have neither an original nor a Smart Preview. - Smart Previews are accepted for processing with the same generated-result checks. Preview-based retouching may need refreshing on originals for full-resolution quality; the guidance is in Help. - Processing checks saved catalog records first, then visits only marked photos in Develop. Photos you merely browsed are skipped. Late-saved marks and undo are reconciled without opening every visited photo. - Fixed the collection error caused by reading its ID before Lightroom finished creating it. - After a batch finishes, Show Marked Photos becomes Show Processed Photos. Confirmed results open in a separate collection for review and further editing. Each run replaces that collection's contents. - Settings now includes Clear Queue, with a short confirmation. Photo edits, recovery snapshots, and original files are kept.
The four-button main panel, saved queue records, and independent update notifications are preserved. An 11-photo native run completed in 0.5.1. Smart Preview-only generation, the revised catalog checks, and the new review/clear controls remain native acceptance tests for this preview.
